# Moneta - v2.0.3

LibreBugBounty 2.0.3 makes screenshot review more focused and responsive while
preserving the classic layout and the existing assessment safeguards.

## Highlights

- **Optional focus mode:** press **F** or use the Focus mode button for a
  window-filling screenshot. Compact overlay controls, a collapsible navigation
  menu and a collapsible/pinnable detail sidebar keep the evidence prominent.
  Hide controls to inspect covered areas; critical notices and errors stay visible.
- **Inspect evidence closely:** fit, 1:1, zoom, mouse/touch panning and pinch zoom.
  Image gestures never record an assessment.
- **Reliable keyboard workflow:** closing navigation, queue information or details
  restores review shortcuts immediately. Mode changes preserve form values and
  the selected screenshot.
- **Smoother transitions:** confirmed saves animate left/right with overlapping
  outgoing and incoming images. Reduced motion is respected; slow or broken
  images and interrupted animations fall back without locking the next card.
- **Background image preloading:** both layouts preload and decode stored images
  for the next two cards in the selected queue, one at a time. Matching images
  and in-flight downloads are reused without a second request. Hidden tabs,
  Save-Data and very slow connections pause new speculative downloads.

## Safety and compatibility

The classic layout remains the default, and normal form navigation still works
without JavaScript. Focus mode is an in-page view, not browser fullscreen.

Only stored local images are prefetched—never review pages or target URLs.
Preloading does not create screenshot jobs, start rechecks, advance the review
trail or assess a finding. The fresh server response remains authoritative.
CSRF/context validation, the decision pause and audited Back/reset behavior are
preserved. An uncertain save response requires an explicit reload instead of
automatically retrying a possibly committed assessment.

## Upgrade

1. Create and verify a [database and artifact backup](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.0.3/BACKUP.md).
2. Update your checkout to **v2.0.3** using your normal deployment workflow.
3. Reload the browser to load the new review scripts and styles; use **F** to
   try focus mode. Check Settings health after deployment.

There are **no new database migrations or worker configuration changes** when
upgrading from 2.0.2. Upgrades from older releases must still apply their pending
migrations using `ddev exec php bin/console app:db:init`.

## Verification

- Full PHP regression suite.
- 21 isolated browser verification blocks covering German/English,
  desktop/mobile, native forms, keyboard/touch interaction, save failures,
  animation cancellation, decision pauses and preload safety.
- Additional Firefox checks for direct reuse of preloaded screenshots in both
  classic and focus mode.

Tests use isolated findings and evidence; no real cases are assessed or external
targets visited.
